It is OUTRAGEOUS that the legit and pronounced political perspective of Democrats is that *some Americans should get paid for the work they’ve done but others shouldn’t. 

Repulsive.

Congress is an embarrassment. The American people suffered for 40 days all so both sides could grandstand and in the end, what was it for?

Discussing today on @OutnumberedFNC noonET FoxNews

Well I think we figured out how to get Senators to do any damn thing, threaten their vacation time.

Maybe this is a new provision, senate doesn’t get to leave (at all) until they fund government and get people the pay they’ve EARNED. 

They think they are so high and mighty while the little guy suffers. End that. 

These people forget who they work for. It’s not the DNC it’s not the RNC, it’s WE THE PEOPLE. They need a major reckoning.
Once again President Trump has to step in and save everyone’s ass in the GOP and get it done. Thank goodness for Trump. Everyone else is as useful as tits on a bull.

Cheryl Hines did not mince words here

Conservatives stand for the veteran. Libs stand for the illegal alien piece of shit. We are not the same.

Cheryl Hines Breaks Her Silence After Chelsea Handler Claimed She and RFK Jr. Sold Her a ‘Toxic’ $6M Home (Exclusive) people.com/cheryl-hines-brea…

We have no leaders in Congress. None. 

The fact that this set of incompetent fools have done this to us twice in the last 6 months is such an embarrassing indictment on who we elected. Both sides. 

And yes, it is DEMOCRATS who are holding it and us hostage to send a message to their rabid base that they love illegal aliens, for sure. 

BUT the simple fact that so many Americans don’t know this, and that Democrats are somehow winning this messaging battle, is an indictment on every single freak

And I will add, though I do agree with what the president and his administration are doing in Iran, it’s pretty hard to continue to convince the American people that what they should be concerned about is the promise of world peace, when we can’t even do basic travel in this country without waiting in hours-long lines, and when Americans who are working in TSA haven’t been paid for a month. 

Everyone wants world peace, but when you can’t fly through the Houston airport without arriving five hou

It is so freaking embarrassing that our members of congress are allowing Americans to go without paychecks and others to wait in hours long lines all because Democrats can’t divorce themselves from their illegal alien love affair and republicans can’t negotiate their way out of a paper bag. 

This is infuriating but so more, it’s f’n pathetic. 

You are all an utter embarrassment to the office and to the American people who sent you there.

American daughters are being volunteered as tribute to be slaughtered at the hands of criminal illegal aliens, all so Democrats can keep as many illegal aliens in this country as possible.

Discussing with @marthamaccallum 345pmET on @TheStoryFNC
